    Associate Judge Nick Malarao was sworn in as an Associate Judge of Te Kōti Matua – High Court at the Auckland High Court on Wednesday 10 June. The ceremony was presided over by the Chief Justice. Guests were welcomed to the Court with a waiata by the Auckland High Court Waiata Rōpū, and mihi whakatau from Justice Natalie Walker. Speeches were given by Solicitor-General Anna Adams KC on behalf of the Government, Mark Davies on behalf of the profession, and Vinney Kumar on behalf of the Kshatriya and Gujarati communities. Associate Judge Malarao will sit in Auckland. sen.nz/9c8wdp #courtsofnz #highcourt #judge

    Justice Natalie Walker was sworn in as a Judge of Te Kōti Matua – High Court at the Auckland High Court on Thursday 4 June. The ceremony was presided over by the Chief Justice. Guests were welcomed to the Court with a waiata by the Auckland High Court Waiata Rōpū, and mihi whakatau from Justice Tahana. Speeches were given by Madeleine Laracy on behalf of the Government, Paul Borich KC on behalf of the profession, and Yasmin Olsen (Ngāpuhi, Te Rarawa, Ngāti Whātua, Ngāti Tīpā) on behalf of the Community.     The High Court today released its Annual Report for 2025. The report outlines the work of the High Court, including its caseload, as well as key developments across the civil and criminal jurisdictions. It highlights the increasing complexity of matters before the Court and ongoing efforts to improve access to justice, including reforms to civil procedure – specifically the Auckland Commercial List, and the work done last year to prepare for the introduction of new High Court Rules to support more efficient case management. Read the 2025 High Court Annual Report here: https://lnkd.in/evkEZisv
